answer: Because selection is random and the dune seed is unrevealed until close, someone cannot dodge the sample, so colluding to grade clones' junk is a island gamble with a negative expected value. A random sample of settled verdicts is re-graded by an independent panel each epoch, and a divergence found on re-check burns the original grader 20% of its standing plus a seat ban. The falcon log keeps the sampled set and the penalty so the deterrent is verifiable. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
